title.narrative: Jordan: Support for Industry Development Fund

description.narrative:
The project will support the implementation of the main programs of the Industry Development Fund, as well as the development of the Fund's governance framework and operational capacity to enable it to become an effective vehicle for the implementation of GOJ's industry development programs beyond the project lifetime. Project disbursements will be provided on reimbursable basis (cover expenditures incurred for the implementation of Fund's programs) to the central budget account. The WB will incorporate lessons learned in supporting development funds, including the design of the governance structure and SOP and stakeholder engagement in preparation and implementation of activities.
The Fund will be established based on a special bylaw that defines the fundamental elements of the Fund's governance structure, management, mandate, financing sources, and financial management. According to the bylaw, the Fund will be housed at MoITS, and its management will be undertaken by the Steering Committee comprised from public and private sector representatives. Fund Management Unit will be established to support the operations of the Fund and implementation and monitoring of its programs.The Fund will not be regulated as a financial institution, and thus its oversight will not involve the Central Bank of Jordan, and the respective requirements for Fund's operations and governance will be defined in a special bylaw, instructions, and methodologies, that will also ensure high transparency and continuity of Fund's operations.
The main activities financed by the Fund will include the following programs: (i) Industry upgrading (to be implemented by JEDCO) and Export development (to be implemented by JE) programs providing matching grants to manufacturing firms to modernize their operations leading to improved product quality and modernized production processes, increased exports through access to new markets and expanding in existing ones, as well as reduction in resource consumption and in waste or emissions; (ii) outcome-based incentives program (to be implemented by MOITS/Fund) providing incentives to firms that achieve targets in areas critical to achieve sector's full potential (higher female employment; introduction of new exportable products; energy/water efficiency; emission reduction; etc.); and (iii) easing access to export credit insurance (to be implemented by JLGC) and to new supply chain finance products.
To promote investments and exports by project beneficiary firms in the manufacturing sector and to operationalize the Industry Development Fund
